title: Angel of the Golden Aura
description: Every noble can manifest a colored “aura”… or should be able to. Despite her noble birth, Reiju was “colorless,” devoid of an aura, and her family used this as justification for their violent abuse. One day, pushed to the brink of death, Reiju awakens with the ability to leave her physical body and travel freely. Moreover, during these astral projections, she can manifest a golden aura – the same color as that of the world’s Creator. But that’s not the end of it. Her golden aura holds a secret power: it can heal people. 見返りは求めていなかった, Mikaeri wa Motomete Inakatta
